sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ时，你每晚也要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，然后把DJ台变成

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 一个活生生的、展示着精美50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, what we're learning about who was behind the plot to kill the president of Haiti.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要了解是谁策划了刺杀海地总统的阴谋。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleagues, Julie Turkowicz in Columbia and Francis Robles in Miami.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我在哥伦比亚的同事朱莉·图尔科维奇和在迈阿密的弗朗西斯·罗伯斯。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月22日，星期四。

sentences.en: Julie, the last time we talked about the assassination of Haiti's president,
sentences.zh: 朱莉，上次我们在《每日新闻》讨论海地总统遇刺事件时，

sentences.en: Jovanel Moise on the Daily, all that we knew was that a group of what had been described as highly trained men, many of them speaking English and Spanish, and some of them claiming
sentences.zh: 也就是若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺时，我们所知的一切就是：一群被描述为训练有素的人，其中许多人讲英语和西班牙语，还有一些人自称

sentences.en: to be American drug enforcement agents, walked into the president's home and without any real resistance, fatally shot him.
sentences.zh: 是美国缉毒局特工，他们走进总统家中，在没有遇到真正抵抗的情况下，将其枪杀。

sentences.en: So where does your reporting pick up?
sentences.zh: 那么你的调查进展如何？

sentences.en: So my reporting picks up when Colombian officials come out just after the assassination and
sentences.zh: 我的调查始于哥伦比亚官员在暗杀发生后立即发表声明，

sentences.en: announced that several of the individuals arrested by Haitian officials are not only Colombians, but Colombian former soldiers, many of whom have just retired.
sentences.zh: 宣布被海地官员逮捕的几个人不仅是哥伦比亚人，而且是哥伦比亚退伍军人，其中许多人刚退役不久。

sentences.en: And I live here in Bogota, in Colombia, and I realized that I'm definitely going to be a part of this reporting.
sentences.zh: 我住在哥伦比亚的波哥大，我意识到我肯定会参与到这次报道中。

sentences.en: And so myself and my colleague Anatoly Kurmanayev decide that we're going to start to try and figure out who these guys are and why they decided to go to Haiti.
sentences.zh: 于是，我和我的同事阿纳托利·库尔马纳耶夫决定开始调查这些人是谁，以及他们为什么决定去海地。
zh_words: 阿纳托利·库尔马纳耶夫

sentences.en: What did they know about this project and what brought them there?
sentences.zh: 他们对这个项目了解多少？是什么把他们带到了那里？

sentences.en: We realized very quickly that we cannot interview these individuals because they are in Haitian custody
sentences.zh: 我们很快意识到，我们无法采访这些人，因为他们被关押在海地，

sentences.en: and we don't know where they're being held or who has contact with them.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他们被关在哪里，也不知道谁能接触到他们。

sentences.en: But what we can do is talk to their relatives.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以做的是采访他们的亲属。

sentences.en: And so the two of us, working with two other reporters here on the ground, begin to interview the wives and other family members of these soldiers.
sentences.zh: 于是我们两人，与当地另外两名记者合作，开始采访这些士兵的妻子和其他家庭成员。

sentences.en: And we interviewed about 30 individuals and basically asked them to walk us through what the recruitment process looked like.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了大约30个人，基本上是请他们带我们梳理了整个招募过程。

sentences.en: And what did you learn from these dozens of people that you interviewed?
sentences.zh: 你从采访的这几十个人那里了解到了什么？

sentences.en: So many of these men have very similar stories.
sentences.zh: 这些人中有很多人的故事非常相似。

sentences.en: And, you know, we spoke to many, many wives.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们和很多很多妻子谈过。

sentences.en: And one who stuck out to us was a woman named Diana.
sentences.zh: 其中一位让我们印象深刻，她叫戴安娜。

sentences.en: Diana's husband is one of the soldiers who is currently held in Haitian custody.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜的丈夫就是目前被关押在海地的士兵之一。

sentences.en: He's accused in this murder.
sentences.zh: 他被指控参与了这起谋杀案。

sentences.en: And his name is Franco Castaneda.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫佛朗哥·卡斯塔涅达。

sentences.en: And Franco is 39 years old.
sentences.zh: 佛朗哥今年39岁。

sentences.en: He lives in Cali.
sentences.zh: 他住在卡利。

sentences.en: He has two children.
sentences.zh: 他有两个孩子。

sentences.en: And Franco has just retired from the Colombian military.
sentences.zh: 佛朗哥刚从哥伦比亚军队退役。

sentences.en: And he is, like many of these men, desperate for work that can really help his family get ahead.
sentences.zh: 像许多这样的人一样，他迫切需要一份能真正帮助家庭改善生活的工作。

sentences.en: And so one day earlier this year, Franco gets this message.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候的一天，佛朗哥收到了这条消息。

sentences.en: And the message comes from his old military buddy named Duvernay Capador, who sometimes goes by the name Manuel.
sentences.zh: 消息来自他以前的军中好友，名叫杜韦奈·卡帕多尔，有时也叫曼努埃尔。

sentences.en: And Capador has this enticing opportunity.
sentences.zh: 卡帕多尔提供了一个诱人的机会。

sentences.en: And he says he has a security job in Central America for a mission that is backed by the
sentences.zh: 他说他在中美洲有一份安保工作，任务是由

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府支持的。

sentences.en: The job is with an American company.
sentences.zh: 这份工作是一家美国公司提供的。

sentences.en: And this job, Capador claims, is going to allow Franco to do the work that he's familiar with, which is protecting people from bad actors.
sentences.zh: 卡帕多尔声称，这份工作将让佛朗哥从事他熟悉的工作，即保护人们免受不法分子的侵害。

sentences.en: And on top of all of this, this job, the recruiter says, will pay Franco $2,700 a month, which for Franco and many of these soldiers is a life-changing amount of money.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，招聘人员说，这份工作每月会给佛朗哥2700美元，这对佛朗哥和许多这样的士兵来说，是一笔能改变生活的钱。

sentences.en: Why is that a life-changing amount of money?
sentences.zh: 为什么这是一笔能改变生活的钱？

sentences.en: So Colombia has been engaged in a very long war with left-wing guerrillas, with paramilitaries, with narco-trafficking groups.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚长期以来一直卷入与左翼游击队、准军事组织和毒品贩运集团的战争中。

sentences.en: And all of these men joined the military at one of the most dangerous points of the war in 2000.
sentences.zh: 这些人都是在2000年战争最危险的时期加入军队的。

sentences.en: And they have now reached retirement age.
sentences.zh: 他们现在已经到了退休年龄。

sentences.en: Retirement age in the Colombian military is after 20 years of service, unless you're going to continue to move up the ranks.
sentences.zh: 除非继续晋升，否则哥伦比亚军队的退休年龄是服役20年后。

sentences.en: And when they retire, they are given a pension.
sentences.zh: 他们退役时会获得一笔养老金。

sentences.en: But that pension is very small, about $400 a month, which is really just above minimum wage.
sentences.zh: 但那笔养老金很少，每月大约400美元，实际上只比最低工资高一点点。

sentences.en: So for many of them, working a security job abroad is the pinnacle opportunity.
sentences.zh: 所以对他们中的许多人来说，去国外做安保工作是绝佳的机会。

sentences.en: And so Franco takes this offer and then he gets ready to leave.
sentences.zh: 于是佛朗哥接受了这个提议，并准备出发。

sentences.en: And so what, according to his wife, happens next once he accepts this security job?
sentences.zh: 那么，据他妻子所说，在他接受这份安保工作后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So in June, Diana and her husband prepare for him to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 6月份，戴安娜和丈夫准备让他出国。

sentences.en: And Diana's husband travels from Cali to the capital of Bogotá, and that is where he meets up with several of these men.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜的丈夫从卡利前往首都波哥大，在那里他与几个人会合了。

sentences.en: And for many of these men, it was the first or second time that they'd ever left the country in their entire lives.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的许多人来说，这是他们一生中第一次或第二次离开这个国家。

sentences.en: And many of them don't know where they're going when they arrive at the airport.
sentences.zh: 许多人在到达机场时甚至不知道自己要去哪里。

sentences.en: They pick up their tickets at the airport.
sentences.zh: 他们在机场领取机票。

sentences.en: And they discover that they're going to the Dominican Republic.
sentences.zh: 然后发现他们要去多米尼加共和国。

sentences.en: They fly to the Dominican Republic.
sentences.zh: 他们飞往多米尼加共和国。

sentences.en: And while they're there, it's clear that these men do not believe that they're on a secret mission.
sentences.zh: 当他们在那里时，很明显，这些人并不认为自己在执行秘密任务。

sentences.en: Many of them take photographs of themselves at various tourist sites.
sentences.zh: 许多人在各个旅游景点拍照。

sentences.en: They post them on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 他们把照片发到Facebook上。

sentences.en: They appear to be on vacation.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来像是在度假。

sentences.en: And a few days after that, they are gathered up by their bosses.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他们被老板召集起来，

sentences.en: and they travel by land to a new destination, and they end up in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 陆路前往一个新的目的地，最终抵达了海地。

sentences.en: And they're in Port-au-Prince, and in Port-au-Prince, they are put up in what has been described to us as a compound, a sort of gated villa with a pool.
sentences.zh: 他们在太子港，被安置在我们所描述的“大院”里，那是一种带游泳池的封闭式别墅。

sentences.en: And the next couple of days and weeks appear to pass in a fairly mundane way.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天和几周似乎过得相当平淡。

sentences.en: The men are given English classes, and when they call home to their wives, they start saying small things to their wives in English.
sentences.zh: 这些人被安排上英语课，当他们给家里的妻子打电话时，开始用英语对妻子说一些简单的话。

sentences.en: They do exercises, and they take turns cooking, and they take turns working night guard shifts.
sentences.zh: 他们进行锻炼，轮流做饭，轮流值夜班。

sentences.en: And that's pretty much what we know about their lives.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所知道的关于他们生活的大部分情况。

sentences.en: And the impression that the men gave to their wives is that they were training to do security for someone important.
sentences.zh: 这些人给妻子的印象是，他们正在为某位重要人物提供安保训练。

sentences.en: But they didn't really seem to know, or at least not to reveal to their wives, what they were there to do.
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎并不真正知道，或者至少没有向妻子透露，他们去那里是为了做什么。

sentences.en: So they're kind of just hanging around in Haiti, and it sounds like they don't yet know who they're training to protect or what protecting this person will entail.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只是在海地闲逛，听起来他们还不知道自己是在保护谁，或者保护这个人意味着什么。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They seem to be in the dark for a while.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎在一段时间内都被蒙在鼓里。

sentences.en: But what we know is at some point in Haiti, they're given this presentation.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道的是，在海地的某个时候，他们参加了一场演讲。

sentences.en: And we have an audio recording of that presentation that was passed to my colleague Anatoly from one of the wives of the soldiers in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 我们有一段演讲的录音，是一位在海地的士兵的妻子转交给我同事阿纳托利的。

sentences.en: And from the audio, we can tell that the Colombians are gathered around this leader.
sentences.zh: 从录音中我们可以听出，哥伦比亚人聚集在这位领导人周围。

sentences.en: And the leader identifies himself as being from the security company Worldwide Capital.
sentences.zh: 这位领导人自称来自安保公司“全球资本”。

sentences.en: And from our reporting, we know that Worldwide Capital is a Florida-based company that works
sentences.zh: 根据我们的报道，我们知道“全球资本”是一家总部位于佛罗里达州的公司，与

sentences.en: with CTU, the company that hired Capador, the guy who recruited all of these Colombian soldiers.
sentences.zh: CTU有合作，CTU就是雇佣了卡帕多尔的公司，也就是招募所有这些哥伦比亚士兵的人。

sentences.en: And Worldwide Capital, he claims, is this prestigious and experienced global security
sentences.zh: 他声称，“全球资本”是一家享有盛誉且经验丰富的全球安保

sentences.en: conglomerate that has worked on enormous projects all over the world, including in the United States.
sentences.zh: 企业集团，曾在世界各地参与过巨大的项目，包括在美国。

sentences.en: And this man explains that he has hired the Colombians to help them rebuild Haiti, to, quote, make Haiti great again.
sentences.zh: 这个人解释说，他雇佣哥伦比亚人是为了帮助重建海地，引用他的话说，“让海地再次伟大”。

sentences.en: And he explains to the Colombians that Haiti is in crisis and that these Colombians are going to work with existing security institutions in Haiti so that big investors will come in and strengthen this country in crisis.
sentences.zh: 他向哥伦比亚人解释说，海地正处于危机之中，这些哥伦比亚人将与海地现有的安保机构合作，以便大投资者能够进入并加强这个处于危机中的国家。

sentences.en: And so he's pumping them up and he is painting their mission as this noble, history-changing mission, this greater-than-sum-of-its-parts kind of mission.
sentences.zh: 他正在鼓动他们，并将他们的使命描绘成一项崇高、改变历史的使命，一种超越其本身意义的使命。

sentences.en: And how in this recording do these ex-Columbian soldiers react to this idea that they, soldiers from Colombia, are there to help rebuild Haiti?
sentences.zh: 在录音中，这些哥伦比亚前士兵对他们——来自哥伦比亚的士兵——去帮助重建海地这个想法有什么反应？

sentences.en: That's something I imagine might be a surprise given what they were told at the outset.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他们最初被告知的内容，我想这可能会让他们感到惊讶。

sentences.en: The Colombians react very positively.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚人的反应非常积极。

sentences.en: And in fact, at one point, one of the former soldiers gets up at the end of the speech given by the boss and thanks the boss for allowing him
sentences.zh: 事实上，在老板演讲结束时，其中一名退伍军人站起来，感谢老板让他

sentences.en: and the other former Colombian soldiers to participate in this project.
sentences.zh: 和其他哥伦比亚前士兵参与这个项目。

sentences.en: And this former soldier says that he's here not just because it's a professional opportunity, but because he feels that it's an opportunity to help a country in need.
sentences.zh: 这位前士兵说，他在这里不仅是因为这是一个职业机会，还因为他觉得这是一个帮助有需要的国家的机会。

sentences.en: And he talks about the way that over the past couple of days he's been in Haiti and the poverty that he has seen, he said, it makes us want to cry.
sentences.zh: 他谈到过去几天在海地的所见所闻，谈到他看到的贫困，他说，这让我们想哭。

sentences.en: And then they all line up for a photo.
sentences.zh: 然后他们都排好队拍照。

sentences.en: So this is not at all sounding like a plot to assassinate Haiti's president.
sentences.zh: 所以这听起来一点也不像是刺杀海地总统的阴谋。

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.zh: 远非如此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: — So when does Franco, according to his wife, learn what this is really about?
sentences.zh: 那么，据他妻子所说，佛朗哥是什么时候知道真相的？

sentences.en: — It's not clear when Franco learns exactly what the mission is.
sentences.zh: 佛朗哥具体是什么时候知道任务内容的，目前还不清楚。

sentences.en: But Diana told us that she spoke to Franco the night of the assassination, and they had a very normal conversation.
sentences.zh: 但戴安娜告诉我们，她在暗杀当晚和佛朗哥通过话，他们进行了一次非常正常的谈话。

sentences.en: — About the kids, about the family.
sentences.zh: 谈论孩子，谈论家庭。

sentences.en: And then just hours later, Moïse is assassinated.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，莫伊兹就被暗杀了。

sentences.en: So that's Wednesday, July 7th.
sentences.zh: 那是7月7日，星期三。

sentences.en: All that day, Diana could not get in touch with her husband.
sentences.zh: 那一整天，戴安娜都无法联系上她的丈夫。

sentences.en: She wasn't sure what was going on.
sentences.zh: 她不确定发生了什么。

sentences.en: And on Thursday, the day after the assassination, she hears from him and he tells her that things have gotten complicated
sentences.zh: 周四，也就是暗杀发生的第二天，她收到了他的消息，他告诉她事情变得复杂了，

sentences.en: and that he's hiding out in an embassy.
sentences.zh: 他正躲在某个大使馆里。

sentences.en: And what we know now is that following the assassination,
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道的是，暗杀发生后，

sentences.en: the Colombians scattered throughout the city and some of them hid out in the embassy of Taiwan and were later taken into custody by Haitian authorities.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚人分散在城市各处，其中一些人躲在台湾的大使馆里，后来被海地当局拘留。

sentences.en: And among the people taken was Franco.
sentences.zh: 被捕的人中就有佛朗哥。

sentences.en: And in that conversation between Diana and Franco after the assassination, did Franco say one way or another whether he understood that their mission was to kill Jovanel Moïse?
sentences.zh: 在暗杀后戴安娜和佛朗哥的谈话中，佛朗哥是否明确表示他是否知道他们的任务是杀死若弗内尔·莫伊兹？

sentences.en: In our interview, Diana says, That Franco tells her, they're shooting all around him.
sentences.zh: 在我们的采访中，戴安娜说，佛朗哥告诉她，周围到处都在开枪。

sentences.en: And his commander is dead.
sentences.zh: 他的指挥官死了。

sentences.en: But he doesn't mention the assassination of a president.
sentences.zh: 但他没有提到总统遇刺的事。

sentences.en: And so what does Deanna think happened?
sentences.zh: 那么戴安娜认为发生了什么？

sentences.en: Does she think that her husband knew?
sentences.zh: 她认为她丈夫知道吗？

sentences.en: Does she think he was kept in the dark?
sentences.zh: 她认为他被蒙在鼓里了吗？

sentences.en: Deanna thinks that her husband was lied to by the people who recruited him.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜认为她丈夫被招募他的人欺骗了。

sentences.en: And that he was kept in the dark about what the mission of this operation was.
sentences.zh: 而且他被蒙在鼓里，不知道这次行动的任务是什么。

sentences.en: All of the family members that we spoke to believe that their husbands were duped.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的所有家庭成员都认为他们的丈夫是被骗了。

sentences.en: They all believe that their husbands thought that they were going to do something good, that they were going to protect someone.
sentences.zh: 他们都相信他们的丈夫以为自己要去做好事，以为自己要去保护某人。

sentences.en: And all of the wives think that their husbands were lied to by the people who recruited them.
sentences.zh: 所有的妻子都认为她们的丈夫被招募者欺骗了。

sentences.en: How believable is that?
sentences.zh: 这可信吗？

sentences.en: That at no point did these ex-soldiers know that they were participating in an assassination attempt?
sentences.zh: 这些前士兵在任何时候都不知道他们参与的是一场暗杀企图？

sentences.en: I think that we as journalists need to be extremely skeptical of all accounts.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们作为记者需要对所有的说法保持极度的怀疑。

sentences.en: And what we are hearing is only one side of the story.
sentences.zh: 我们听到的只是故事的一面。

sentences.en: We're not speaking directly with the soldiers.
sentences.zh: 我们没有直接与这些士兵交谈。

sentences.en: And so we're receiving filtered accounts through their family members.
sentences.zh: 所以我们收到的是通过他们的家人过滤后的说法。

sentences.en: However, given the reality for many of these soldiers on the ground in Colombia and for their families,
sentences.zh: 然而，考虑到这些士兵在哥伦比亚的现实情况以及他们的家庭状况，

sentences.en: it is extremely credible to believe that before they left for this operation, they didn't know what they were getting into.
sentences.zh: 相信他们在出发执行这次行动之前不知道自己卷入了什么，是非常可信的。

sentences.en: And if the truth is that they were duped into this whole mission, you know, many of these
sentences.zh: 如果事实是他们被骗参与了整个任务，你知道，这些人中的许多人

sentences.en: individuals talked about using the money that they were going to earn in Haiti to pay off their mortgages, to put their children through school.
sentences.zh: 谈到用他们在海地赚的钱来偿还抵押贷款，供孩子上学。

sentences.en: One woman said that her brother, who's in Haiti now, had promised to buy a wheelchair for a family member.
sentences.zh: 一位妇女说，她现在在海地的兄弟曾承诺给家里人买一把轮椅。

sentences.en: Another wanted to pay for cancer treatment.
sentences.zh: 另一位想支付癌症治疗费用。

sentences.en: If these individuals, in fact, were duped into this operation, it's really sad.
sentences.zh: 如果这些人确实是被骗参与了这次行动，那真的很可悲。

sentences.en: It's really sad.
sentences.zh: 真的很可悲。

sentences.en: And they're likely to spend many years in Haitian prison.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能会在海地的监狱里度过多年。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What is less clear is which of these men knew that it was going to be an assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 不太清楚的是，这些人中有谁知道这将是一次暗杀企图。

sentences.en: And at what point did they learn?
sentences.zh: 他们是在什么时候知道的？

sentences.en: And that is what we're trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们试图弄清楚的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because in a way, these men are portraying themselves as almost victims here, right?
sentences.zh: 因为在某种程度上，这些人把自己描绘成受害者，对吧？

sentences.en: People who were misled, which raises the question if in fact they were tricked, who tricked them?
sentences.zh: 被误导的人，这就引出了一个问题：如果他们确实被骗了，是谁骗了他们？

sentences.en: If none of these men knew what they were getting into, who did know?
sentences.zh: 如果这些人中没有一个人知道自己卷入了什么，那谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the answer to that question lies in the company that recruited them, CTU, which it turns out has major connections to Miami, Florida.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这个问题的答案在于招募他们的公司CTU，事实证明它与佛罗里达州的迈阿密有着重大的联系。

sentences.en: After the break, I speak with my colleague, Francis Robles, about what happened in Miami.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将与我的同事弗朗西斯·罗伯斯（Francis Robles）探讨迈阿密发生的事情。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》（The Reframers），这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ时，你每晚也要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的快闪博物馆，陈列着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to the ReFramers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金（Andrew Ross-Sorkin）。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯（Vance）、埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德（Christine Lagarde）、佐兰·蒙达尼（Zoran Mondani）等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Frenchy, Julie Turkowicz, our colleague, just mentioned a strong connection between this
sentences.zh: 弗朗西，我们的同事朱莉·图尔科维奇（Julie Turkowicz）刚刚提到，这家招募了前哥伦比亚士兵的安保公司与迈阿密之间存在紧密联系，

sentences.en: security company that recruited these ex-Columbian soldiers and Miami, Florida, where I know that you were based for the Times.
sentences.zh: 而我知道你之前曾常驻佛罗里达州迈阿密为《时报》工作。

sentences.en: What is that connection?
sentences.zh: 这种联系是什么？

sentences.en: The company is called CTU Security, and they're based in Miami.
sentences.zh: 这家公司叫CTU安保公司（CTU Security），总部就在迈阿密。

sentences.en: It's a Miami firm.
sentences.zh: 这是一家迈阿密公司。

sentences.en: So the big question is, what were they doing in Haiti, right?
sentences.zh: 所以最大的问题是，他们当时在海地做什么，对吧？

sentences.en: What we do know so far is that there's a doctor in South Florida, a Haitian-American man named Christian Sannin, who hired CTU.
sentences.zh: 我们目前所知的是，南佛罗里达州有一位医生，一位名叫克里斯蒂安·萨农（Christian Sannin）的海地裔美国人，他雇佣了CTU。

sentences.en: And what should we know about this Dr. Sannin?
sentences.zh: 关于这位萨农医生，我们应该了解些什么？

sentences.en: So Dr. Sannin, first of all, it's unclear whether he's actually a medical doctor in Florida.
sentences.zh: 首先，萨农医生是否真的是佛罗里达州的执业医师，这一点尚不清楚。

sentences.en: We don't think he is, but he's an evangelical pastor.
sentences.zh: 我们认为他不是，但他是一位福音派牧师。

sentences.en: He was someone who was very engaged in social projects, particularly in Haiti, building clinics and things like that.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常热衷于社会项目的人，特别是在海地，他会建造诊所之类的设施。

sentences.en: The people who met him, who I interviewed, had great things to say about him as a person who was extremely passionate.
sentences.zh: 我采访过那些见过他的人，他们对他的评价很高，认为他是一个非常有激情的人。

sentences.en: He cared a lot about Haiti.
sentences.zh: 他非常关心海地。

sentences.en: Do you know every Haitian has a passport?
sentences.zh: 你知道每个海地人都有护照吗？

sentences.en: Do you know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because they get ready to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 因为他们随时准备离开这个国家。

sentences.en: And why they want to leave the country is because they are discouraged.
sentences.zh: 他们想离开的原因是他们感到灰心丧气。

sentences.en: They cannot take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们再也无法忍受了。

sentences.en: You know, there's even websites and videos where Dr. Sanem was talking about bringing democracy to Haiti and all of his leadership skills.
sentences.zh: 你知道，甚至还有网站和视频显示萨农医生在谈论为海地带来民主以及他所有的领导才能。

sentences.en: But I want to tell them something.
sentences.zh: 但我想要告诉他们一件事。

sentences.en: There is a hope coming in.
sentences.zh: 希望正在降临。

sentences.en: The new hope that they need to have to have a better life.
sentences.zh: 他们需要拥有新的希望，才能过上更好的生活。

sentences.en: He was going to be a person to solve problems for Haiti.
sentences.zh: 他本打算成为那个为海地解决问题的人。

sentences.en: With me in power,
sentences.zh: 如果我掌权，

sentences.en: You're going to have to tell me, what are you doing with my uranium?
sentences.zh: 你得告诉我，你拿我的铀做什么？

sentences.en: What are you going to do with the oil that we have in the country?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么处理我们国家拥有的石油？

sentences.en: Nine million people cannot be in poverty when we have so much resource in the country.
sentences.zh: 当我们国家拥有如此丰富的资源时，九百万人不应该生活在贫困之中。

sentences.en: It's impossible.
sentences.zh: 这不可能。

sentences.en: He cared so much about Haiti that he wanted to bring a transitional government to Haiti and become prime minister should the presidency fall.
sentences.zh: 他非常关心海地，以至于他想为海地带来一个过渡政府，并在总统职位空缺时出任总理。

sentences.en: And why did he see himself as somebody who could lead Haiti?
sentences.zh: 为什么他认为自己是一个能领导海地的人？

sentences.en: I have asked that question seven ways from Sunday, and I have not gotten a straight answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我用尽各种方式问过这个问题，但都没有得到一个直接的回答。

sentences.en: I mean, it makes sense that you would think that this government would fall because you have to put yourself six, eight, nine months ago in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为政府会倒台是有道理的，因为你得把自己置身于六、八、九个月前的海地。

sentences.en: The streets were packed with protesters.
sentences.zh: 街上挤满了抗议者。

sentences.en: You had a president in power where there was question as to whether he had overstayed his term.
sentences.zh: 当时在任的总统是否已经超期服役都成了问题。

sentences.en: He had a very damaging report that came out showing massive amounts of government misspending, which the people on the streets were furious about.
sentences.zh: 一份非常具有破坏性的报告显示政府存在大量资金滥用，街上的人们对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And you had more and more control that the gangs had over the streets.
sentences.zh: 而且帮派对街道的控制力越来越强。

sentences.en: And people were really, really upset.
sentences.zh: 人们真的、真的非常不满。

sentences.en: And they were directing all that anger at President Moise.
sentences.zh: 他们把所有的愤怒都指向了莫伊兹（Moise）总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it was reasonable to suspect that perhaps Moisa's government was teetering on the edge and might fall.
sentences.zh: 所以怀疑莫伊兹政府可能摇摇欲坠并最终倒台是合理的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, it's logical to think that the guy wasn't going to be able to continue in the presidency.
sentences.zh: 你知道，认为那个人无法继续担任总统是合乎逻辑的。

sentences.en: It is not logical, as far as I can tell, for Dr. Sinan to think that he would be tapped.
sentences.zh: 但据我所知，萨农医生认为自己会被选中，这并不合乎逻辑。

sentences.en: Why him?
sentences.zh: 为什么是他？

sentences.en: You know, he doesn't even live in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 要知道，他甚至不住在海地。

sentences.en: He was living in South Florida.
sentences.zh: 他住在南佛罗里达。

sentences.en: but he told people that he had the backing of Democrats and Republicans in the United States
sentences.zh: 但他告诉人们，他得到了美国民主党和共和党的支持，

sentences.en: and that's a big deal in Haiti you know the United States kind of calls a lot of the shots there
sentences.zh: 这在海地可是件大事，你知道，美国在某种程度上主导着那里的一切。

sentences.en: and he was kind of self-appointed that this is what we're going to do and we're going to make
sentences.zh: 他有点自封的意思，认为这就是我们要做的，我们要建立一个伟大的政府，

sentences.en: this great government and we're going to build highways and roads and we're going to improve
sentences.zh: 我们要修建高速公路和道路，我们要改善学校，我们要制止绑架，所以他开始举行一系列会议，

sentences.en: the schools and we're going to put a stop to the kidnappings and so he starts holding a series of
sentences.zh: 为了实现这些目标，为了在政府倒台时做好一切准备。

sentences.en: meetings to make that happen, to have everything ready in place if the government should collapse.
sentences.zh: 这些会议有各种专家参加，有专门研究健康的，有专门研究基础设施项目的。

sentences.en: These meetings were attended by a variety of experts, people who specialized in health, people who specialized in infrastructure projects.
sentences.zh: 我交谈了几个小时的人之一，是佛罗里达州布劳沃德县的一位退休经济学教授。

sentences.en: One of the people that I talked to for hours, he's a retired economics professor in Broward County, Florida.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫帕内尔·杜韦尔热（Parnell DuVergere），他参加了至少十几场这样的会议。

sentences.en: His name is Parnell DuVergere, and he attended at least a dozen of these meetings.
sentences.zh: 杜韦尔热先生亲自为高速公路和桥梁准备了这个800亿美元的公共工程项目，这些都是常规的工作会议，就像内阁会议一样。

sentences.en: Mr. DuVergé himself prepared this $80 billion public works project for highways and bridges, and they were regular work meetings, almost like if it was a cabinet.
sentences.zh: 他对自己所做的工作感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: And he was really proud of the work that he did.
sentences.zh: 他是一位自豪的海地人，致力于他认为非常重要的事情，与一个他认为对为海地带来变革、民主和安全充满激情的人共事。

sentences.en: He was a proud Haitian working on something what he believed was really important with a person he believed was really passionate about bringing change
sentences.zh: 但我们谈话开始时提到的与CTU的联系又是怎么回事呢？

sentences.en: and democracy and security to Haiti.
sentences.zh: 雇佣那家公司，而那家公司又雇佣了这些前哥伦比亚士兵。

sentences.en: But what about this connection to CTU that we started the conversation with?
sentences.zh: 这些专家知道这次雇佣吗？

sentences.en: Hiring that company, which in turn hired these ex-Colombian soldiers.
sentences.zh: 如果他们知道，他们对为什么要将这些前哥伦比亚士兵引入这个过程有什么理解？

sentences.en: Did these experts know of that hiring?
sentences.zh: 那位经济学教授参加了春天在劳德代尔堡举行的一次会议，CTU在会上做了陈述，他们谈到了自己的专业知识，你知道，

sentences.en: And if they did, what was their understanding of why these ex-Columbian soldiers were being brought into the process?
sentences.zh: 军事装备、防弹背心和保安人员。

sentences.en: The economics professor was there for a meeting in Fort Lauderdale that took place in the spring where CTU gave a presentation and they talked about their expertise, you know,
sentences.zh: 他并不觉得这有什么不寻常。

sentences.en: military equipment and bulletproof vests and security guards.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你必须再次记住海地的背景，那里的绑架事件多得惊人。

sentences.en: And he didn't find it that unusual.
sentences.zh: 你知道，牧师在教堂里被绑架。

sentences.en: You know, you have to remember, again, the Haiti context where kidnappings are through the roof.
sentences.zh: 所以，一家安保公司进来为这个新政府提供安全保障的想法似乎完全合乎逻辑。

sentences.en: You know, pastors are getting snatched in the middle of their churches.
sentences.zh: 所以对于像这位经济学教授这样的人来说，CTU只是众多专家中的一员。

sentences.en: So the thought that a security firm would be coming in to provide safety for this new administration seems perfectly logical.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So to someone like this economics professor, CTU was just one more expert in the mix.
sentences.zh: 这些专家，包括你交谈过的那位教授，

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 他们中有人对为什么这位海地裔美国医生会成为海地领导人，或者他是否真的得到美国支持表示怀疑吗？

sentences.en: Did these experts, including this professor that you spoke with,
sentences.zh: 他们是否怀疑过这一切？

sentences.en: did any of these folks express any skepticism about why this Haitian-American doctor of all people would become the leader of Haiti or whether he was really backed by the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 我可能问了杜韦尔热先生15次这个问题，我一直在逼问他，因为我实在无法理解。

sentences.en: Were they doubting any of this?
sentences.zh: 这太令人费解了。

sentences.en: I asked Mr. DuVergé that question probably 15 times, and I was really pressing him because I just didn't understand it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像，你为什么认为这家伙会成为总理？

sentences.en: It's such a head-scratcher.
sentences.zh: 为什么是他？

sentences.en: You know, like, why did you think that this guy was going to be prime minister?
sentences.zh: 他有什么特别之处？

sentences.en: Why him?
sentences.zh: 他认识谁，竟然拍拍他的肩膀说，哦，你，佛罗里达州布劳沃德县的一位普通福音派牧师，

sentences.en: What's so special about him?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不来管理这个政府？

sentences.en: Who does he know that tapped him on the shoulder to say, oh, you, random evangelical pastor in Broward County, Florida,
sentences.zh: 杜韦尔热先生说，他表现得像是一个在美国有很多支持的人，他非常有说服力。

sentences.en: Why don't you come run this government?
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，没有任何证据表明美国政府在他背后支持他。

sentences.en: And what Mr. Duvalier said was that he presented himself as a person who had a lot of backing in the United States, that he was very convincing.
sentences.zh: 我没有那样的证据，没有。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, there is no evidence that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在两三个小时的采访快结束时，他终于说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: government was behind him.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他是个骗子。

sentences.en: I don't have that evidence, no.
sentences.zh: 我很尴尬，我竟然没看出来。

sentences.en: And then at the ends of probably two or three hours of interviews, he finally said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: I think he's a con man.
sentences.zh: 当莫伊兹被暗杀时，你采访过的所有这些专家有什么反应？

sentences.en: And I'm so embarrassed that I didn't catch it.
sentences.zh: 当总统被暗杀时，每个人都感到震惊，而几天后，当萨农医生被牵连并作为整个谋杀阴谋的潜在主谋被捕时，他们又震惊了好几次。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 警方甚至说，当他们去逮捕他时，在他的房子里发现了缉毒局（DEA）的帽子和弹药。

sentences.en: What was the reaction of all these experts that you've been talking to when Moise is assassinated?
sentences.zh: 缉毒局的帽子很重要，因为莫伊兹被杀的那晚，刺客伪装成了缉毒局特工。

sentences.en: Everybody was shocked when the president was assassinated, and they were shocked several times over a few days later when Dr. Sannin is implicated and arrested
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: as a potential mastermind of this whole murder plot.
